クレームに

対応の仕方、5選

理不尽な場面でも、冷静に送れます。

publish.title: 理不尽なクレームに言い返せない人へ。冷静に見える対応5選

hypothesis: Customer-facing complaint handling is a higher-stakes context than internal workplace friction; testing it should show whether the phrase-swap payoff still lands when the audience is external.
